en: Go ahead.
Saejima⑬over there!
That's a trap site. There are many like it on the mountain. You just have to find them and set up traps on them.
Any trap sites you find will be automatically marked on the map.
Go ahead and set up a snare.
The first step is to walk up close to a trap site.
*pant* I just need to rest a little...
Alright there?
You know what?
I heard about an old man in the village. He's been after that monster for years, apparently?
Yeah. That's Okudera-han.
How does he keep going against a force of nature like that? Is it for the money? Bragging rights?
Where does he find the will to keep chasing that thing?
That's something I'd love to know myself.
But it sure ain't money or braggin' rights. The man's not moved by that type of thing.
Don't think anyone could keep up their motivation that way, actually. I'm still here 'cause I wanna know what inspires these folk.
...Hey, we can't dawdle here much longer. Can ya manage now?
Ya doin' good. Almost there.
I'm... saved.
(That tree... Is that the Ghost Pine?)
(That's it. Should be a time capsule buried at its foot.)
(Alright. Let's get diggin'.)
(Found the little bugger.)
You found <Color:8>Time Capsule<Color:Default>.
(Whew... Didn't know frozen ground was so tough to dig in. That fella in the village is lucky he didn't hafta do this.)
Pick up the pace, Suzuki-san.
Enjoying taxi driving?
Yes, things are going well.
Yeah? Guess you're made for the job, Suzuki-san.
It's still a bit difficult.
Yeah, it can be rough sometimes.
I'm having a really hard time.
Don't sweat it. You gotta start somewhere.
I know I told you I wasn't in a hurry, but this is ridiculous.
I've never had such a terrible taxi ride before! Ugh, just let me out here.
Yes, I'll go ahead and do that.
What the hell is your problem!?
That'd be good, thanks.
Great. I'm going to be late now.
Your driving is horrendous! I've just about had enough. Let me out here!
It's my daughter's piano recital today.
I'm always late because of work.
She told me to be sure I'm there on time today.
It matters to my daughter!
My family is just as important as my work!
Yes, I wouldn't want to disappoint my daughter.
Good. I think we should make it, though.
Don't go taking any risks.
Am I talking to a brick wall?
Think you're going to make it on time?
It's good to see a driver who's careful about safety.
Hey, I was just asking.
Grr! I told you I was in a hurry! That's it. I'm just going to walk.
You're an awful driver! No way I'm riding in a death taxi like this!
Just get me there on the double!
I can't afford to be late today.
What are you talking about? Driving's your job.
Great! That's reassuring!
Thanks! But do drive carefully. I wouldn't want you to crash.
Hello? You listening?
Today is my grandson's birthday. I wanted to look my best, but ending up taking too long to get ready.
Oh, I got a text from my grandson. He says they're going to start without me! This is a disaster!
Really? Well, I'm in your hands now. Let's not waste any time!
Give up? How could you say that? Just hurry up and get me there!
And what good would that do? Ugh, just hurry up and get me there already!
Are you ignoring me!? Come on, step on it!
Urp! This ain't gonna work!
Hurk... Your driving sucks! I need to vomit, just let me out!
Man, I feel bad asking for a ride when I'm so drunk.
I know I'm putting you out here.
Sorry, I'll try not to throw up.
Yeah, right. I know you're just humoring me.
Sure, just pretend I'm not here. Urp.
Ohh, I don't think I can hold it in.
What do I do!?
Thanks, that'll help.
Yeah, I heard that's a good idea.
If that worked, nobody would ever have to throw up.
You're not even listening, are you?
Uh-oh... I think I...
Yikes! This is one bumpy ride. I don't think I can hold it in!
Gah! My bladder is gonna burst!
I'm about to spring a leak here!
Gah, I guess I can hold on if we're nearly there!
You're not making this any easier!
Why would I want a drink at a time like this?
You hear me?
Oh no. I'm getting the urge to go again.
You have any advice to help me get through this?
Okay! I'll do my best!
Huh? I don't think that's a good idea.
Yeah! It's mind over matter!
Uh, hello?
Mom, this taxi's going sooo slow. Let's just get out here already!
Mom, this guy's driving is making me dizzy!
Hey, driver.
Is Santa Claus real?
That's kind of you to say.
How can you be so cruel?
Hahaha. That's funny.
What kind of man ignores a child?
How are babies born?
Thank you for being prudent.
Hey! Now is not the time!
Sorry about the awkward question.
You shouldn't ignore kids.
For a taxi driver, you're pretty slow going.
Oh man, I don't wanna die. Let me out of here!
Time for a pop quiz!
Question number one!
What's my blood type?
Geez, talk about rude!
Bzzzt, wrong! The correct answer was alien blood!
I wish you'd at least take a guess.
Huh? You ignoring me? Come on!
On to question number two! What's my name?
Hey, you mad at me for some reason?
Bzzzt, wrong! I'll have to keep the answer a secret, though. I'm a private person, okay!
Nope, it's not Tricky or Ricky! Hehehe.
Not speaking to me or something? Hmph.
Look, driver! There's a UFO over there!
I got you! Hehehe. You should have seen your face.
Oh, come on. At least play along with me.
What? Am I annoying you or something?
So you're just going to ignore me?
Oww. My stomach is really sore all of a sudden.
Yeah, I was faking. But how could you tell?
Hmph. At least show a little concern.
Ha, fooled you! Thanks for showing you care, though.
Hey, I was talking to you. You hear me?
Uh-oh. I'm out of time.
No, no. This won't do at all. Can you just let me out here?
As fast as you can.
Make that super fast.
Triple the speed limit would be even better.
What!? I was only joking!
I know. It was just a joke.
Yeah, that'd be best.
Huh? Are you even listening?
Ugh, that car is going so slow!
What the hell's their problem?
Just don't trigger any road rage.
Huh!? That's taking it too far.
Please do!
Hmm? Didn't you hear me?
(I see somethin'.)
You picked up Old Map Scrap A.
Old Map completed!
(There's somethin' written on it. A riddle? Might pay to solve it.)
So, you found it at last.
Yikes, don't give me that look. I was just trying to create a little atmosphere.
Er, let me introduce myself. I'm Tokuyama, head of the Tsukimino Merchants Association.
What you picked up there is a key item in the treasure hunt event we're holding right now!
Treasure hunt?
That's right. There are 24 other pieces just like the one you have. So that makes a total of 25 map pieces scattered around town.
A single piece isn't much use. But as you collect the others, you can put them together to make treasure maps.
There are five treasure maps in total. In other words, each is split into five pieces.
Huh. So five treasure maps are scattered 'round town, split into 25 pieces?
That's right! And what's more, the completed treasure maps take the form of riddles!
We racked our brains and came up with the toughest riddles we could. Only those who solve them can claim the treasure.
So, what do you say? Have I got you all fired up to go on a treasure hunting adventure?
Guess I'll pick 'em up if I spot 'em.
Oh, don't play coy with me! I know you're all revved up and ready to go, you old grump.
Er, anyway, I hope you enjoy the event!
